blocks.text: King George Corridor homes listed and sold, June to October 2026

King George Corridor, October 2026. Detached houses: 84 listed at month end and 3 sold in October, a sales ratio of 4% (a buyers’ market). Condos and townhomes: 115 listed at month end and 18 sold in October, a sales ratio of 16% (a balanced market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 42 sold over 5 months against an average of 85.6 listed, about 10.2 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 14 sold. Condos and townhomes: 107 sold over 5 months against an average of 133.8 listed, about 6.3 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was September with 27 sold.

faq.q: Is King George Corridor the whole of King George Boulevard?
faq.a: No — not on this page, in the City plan or in the board data. The King George Corridor plan area and sub-area run from 8 Avenue to the Nicomekl River in South Surrey, bordered by Highway 99 to the east; the boulevard continues north through Newton to City Centre, but those stretches sit in other sub-areas.

faq.q: What transit is planned for the boulevard?
faq.a: King George Boulevard BRT: approximately 19 km with 12 stations from Surrey City Centre to Semiahmoo Town Centre, dedicated lanes along most of the route, peak service every five minutes and peak end-to-end times of about 40 minutes; Council has moved it to full design.

faq.q: Can a house lot in the corridor add units?
faq.a: Under Surrey's SSMUH framework, most eligible lots under 4,050 m² inside the Urban Containment Boundary can carry 3 units (under 280 m²) or 4 units (280 m² or more), and eligible lots within 400 m of a frequent bus stop can carry up to 6 — boulevard-adjacent lots may qualify, so check the parcel's zone and Frequent Bus Stop Area status in COSMOS.

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in King George Corridor?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 84 houses listed with 3 sold in the month and 115 condos and townhomes listed with 18 sold in the month in King George Corridor. Those are month-end counts and move daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is King George Corridor a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 4%, a buyers’ market; condos and townhomes had a sales ratio of 16%, a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.
